product: Elephant Validation OS v1.2 / Target-Aware Point-in-Time-Gated Challenger

data_confidence_v2.method: weighted geometric confidence; completeness 30%, freshness 25%, source reliability 25%, revision-evidence maturity 20%

revision_evidence.note: Evidence-maturity factor, not a claim that official data never revise. No prospective history means confidence cannot start at 100.

data_confidence_v2.note: This is evidence confidence, not probability that a Score is correct and not a return forecast.

score_challengers.method: Compare production vs predeclared equal-weight weights on dimension-appropriate future composites; future Cycle is secondary diagnostic rather than a universal target.
score_challengers.comparison_contract: paired common-sample comparison on identical score periods and identical dimension-appropriate future outcomes; minimum 36 common observations at both 3M and 6M before review

growth_persistence.meaning: future export orders + exports + manufacturing production/sales + inventory-balance composite

domestic_demand.meaning: future real wage + employment + retail/food/card-spending composite

financial_conditions.meaning: future money/credit/rate financial-conditions composite; FX remains diagnostic weight zero

ai_concentration.meaning: future concentration persistence, not economic-health direction

score_challengers.promotion_boundary: Revised historical reconstruction may screen challengers but cannot promote them. Promotion requires sufficient prospective point-in-time vintages plus a versioned governance review.

portfolio.scope: Aggregate equity envelope only; user private holdings are not stored or scored here.

evidence_boundary.reconstructed_history: Historical score rows before vintage collection remain revised-series reconstructions.
evidence_boundary.revision_evidence: Revision stability starts conservative and matures only through prospective vintages.
evidence_boundary.score_challenger: Equal-weight baseline changes weights only in-memory and restores production weights before returning.
evidence_boundary.prospective_journal: No outcome is counted if it was already known when the validation snapshot was recorded.
